scene: You slide down the rope onto a buzzing elevated transit deck.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view of a wooden rooftop transit deck. On the far left hangs a suspended striped gondola cabin. To its right stands the Pacific Islander girl clutching her sketchbook. In the centre sits a brass clockwork carousel train, and on the far right waits a glassy pneumatic capsule dock.
shown: a striped passenger gondola dangling from an overhead cable, far left, open door waiting
a brass clockwork carousel train puffing steam on mini tracks, centre, hatch open
a clear pneumatic tube capsule resting in a suction dock, far right, hatch open
